chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
My father, peace be upon him, used to dislike riding upon the sea for trade.

key_terms.أَحَدِهِمَا: One of the two Imams, referring contextually to al-Bāqir or al-Ṣādiq عليهما السلام
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: A prominent transmitter narrating this hadith
key_terms.يَكْرَهُ: He disliked or regarded as disliked

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about traveling by sea for trade?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that an Imam عليه السلام related that his father عليه السلام disliked sea travel for commercial purposes. It indicates a cautious stance toward engaging in trade through sea voyaging, and is relevant to discussions of legal and practical rulings connected to travel by ship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1330 - Muhammad ibn Muslim reported from one of the Imams (as) who said:
"My father (as) disliked traveling by sea for trade."
